instruction: Please enable the scrollbars in GIMP's image window.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling scrollbars in GIMP. Uses existing check_config_status metric to verify show-scrollbars setting in sessionrc config file. Same difficulty level as original - single UI element visibility toggle.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement - enabling scrollbars in GIMP's image window
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) extracts the correct state - GIMP's sessionrc config file which contains scrollbar settings
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses the config file and checks for the key-value pair 'show-scrollbars yes'
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are written to disk before verification
Complete coverage - instruction has one requirement and evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Logic handles GIMP's S-expression config format correctly by stripping parentheses and parsing key-value pairs
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: JSON has typo 'type:' instead of 'type' on line 44, though this doesn't affect functionality since only the 'rules' object is used
